{{Quote|A friend of mine from the Academy has a friend on Bestine who might enable us to make contact with an armed Rebel unit.|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope (novel)">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Bestine IV''', or simply '''Bestine''', was an aquacultural [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. Nearly all of its surface was covered by a vast [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], but there were many rugged islands spread across the planet. The original population struggled for years atop the planet's [[Island spires/Legends|Island Spires]] to create an island paradise. As time passed, the planet was more widely known for its ship repair and construction industry, which eventually caught on with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who constructed large naval shipyards.

==History==
===Early history===
Early colonization attempts of Bestine were problematic, with a series of [[Kian'thar]] settlements being tried and abandoned from [[278 BBY/Legends|278]] to [[211 BBY]]. Eventually, in [[170 BBY/Legends|170 BBY]], a [[H'kig]] commune was successfully established.<ref name="TEA" />

It was after this planet that [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] capital, [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], was named by Bestinian survivors of the [[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']] wreck. Some locations on Tatooine were named after locations on Bestine IV; for example, Tatooine's [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]] was named after Bestine IV's island [[Tusken (island)|Tusken]].<ref name="SoT" />

===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had a [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] at Bestine. In the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the war, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]], led a [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|mission]] on [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek's]] [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] in an attempt to capture [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. During the mission, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fil/Legends|Fil]] had [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Niner/Legends|Niner]] and [[Bel/Legends|Bel]] contact the fleet for reinforcements in capturing Grievous. However, they were unable to when their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was destroyed by a [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] using a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]].<ref name="LoG" />

===Imperial Era===
The planet had become increasingly attractive due to Bestine's small but growing ship repair and construction industry, which can be credited to the planet's unique oceanic based shipyards that were designed primarily to quickly produce [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-sized vessels.<ref name="EAWGG" />

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], its populace was displaced for the construction of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] naval yard. This project was simply a massive expansion of the present naval shipyards, which were curiously located on the surface of the ocean, not in orbit. The displaced populace were promised a "new and exciting home", but, when the promise wasn't kept, most ended up scattering to other systems. Many joined with or aided [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on Bestine, although they were never able to successfully sabotage the Imperial shipyards which had been code-named [[Juggerhead]]. The shipyards gave the impression that they were constructing [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], although in fact it was conducting research and development on a sleek, single-seat attack submersible, the [[TIE torpedo]].<ref name="TEA" /> Bestine was later the location of an important Rebel base.<ref name="Xwing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Bestine_eaw.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bestine during the Galactic Civil War.]]

During the Alliance to Restore the Republic's [[Operation Skyhook|investigation]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], and while [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Bestine IV, the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] was [[Attack on the Defiance|engaged]] by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'', which launched squadrons of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to destroy her. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were able to tarry them, until the ''Defiance'' [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] away. The [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] was later [[Attack on the Independence|attacked]] in a similar way.<ref name="Xwing" />

Bestine IV was the homeworld of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Porkins]]<ref name="trilogy-sb">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]].<ref name="TEA" /> Also the [[Twin/Legends|twin]] female rebel pilots [[Tia (pilot)|Tia]] and [[Ghia]].

===Later history===
Bestine IV stayed under remnant Imperial control until [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Following the defeat of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], Imperial forces cleared the Juggerhead facilities and abandoned the planet. Bestine IV became part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soon after.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] conquered Bestine sometime around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. It was later [[Battle of the Bestine system|recaptured]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bestine is first mentioned in dialogue in the deleted scene "Tosche Station" from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|film's novelization]] written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]. In both [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] refers to a friend who has a friend "on Bestine" who might help them make contact with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces.<ref name="Tosche Station">{{Film|IV}} {{C|Deleted scenes}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope (novel)" /> It is possible that Darklighter is referring to [[Bestine (city)/Legends|the city]] located on Tatooine, but because Darklighter says ''on'' Bestine, rather than ''in'', he is most likely referring to the planet rather than the city.
